gold.notes: One accent at two lightnesses: #83682A on the paper ground (4.77:1, it carries text), #C8A24A inside a .dark film frame (7.72:1 on ink). Same hue and saturation, so it reads as one colour.

ink.notes: Primary text on paper — and the ground INSIDE a film frame. Scoped with .dark, never on <html>.

clay.notes: Set for legibility on a white card (4.61:1); brightens to #C97A4E inside a film frame.

paper.notes: The document ground everywhere. ~60% of any surface.

display.purpose: Hero and page titles only — high contrast, large-only.

prose.purpose: Editorial body: descriptions, bios, licence text.

eyebrow.purpose: Tracked gold overline above a headline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for colour and border transitions.

narrative.northStar: The Gallery, Not the Vendor's Table
narrative.overview: Laqta is the Saudi stock footage library. The page is paper; the film is not. An off-white ground with quiet warm chrome, and dark cinematic frames set into it — a gallery hangs work on a light wall because the wall is not competing. Dark is a property of the FRAME, scoped with .dark to the hero cinematic, footage placeholders and overlays on imagery; never the document default. One accent, one type family in three cuts, and enormous restraint with colour. Arabic leads everywhere, RTL by default.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#FAF8F3) site-wide; the film frames inside it are ink
One accent (gold), rationed to money / primary action / active state only
Gold is theme-aware: #83682A on paper, #C8A24A on film — one colour, two grounds
Thmanyah superfamily: Serif Display large, Serif Text for prose, Sans for UI
The letterbox (2.39:1) as the recurring geometry — the shape of the product
Generous margins; content holds the middle two-thirds

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold means money, the primary action, or the active state — nothing else. Well under 15% of any screen. If two gold things compete for the eye, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Dark-Is-A-Frame Rule
rules.body: .dark describes footage, never chrome. Scoped to the cinematic, cover placeholders and overlays on imagery. The document is paper. A surface reaching for .dark to look premium has misread the system.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Headline Rule
rules.body: A headline is one size set as two lines — a Light lead over a Bold statement. Arabic copy splits on its comma.

rules.name: The Isolated-Latin Rule
rules.body: Any Latin run inside Arabic is wrapped .ltr-island or .numeric. Text of unknown script — a search query, a claimant name — goes in <bdi> so it picks its own direction. Dates and money go in an inner numeric span, never on a flex element.

rules.name: The Status-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Oasis, clay and destructive appear only as state. Each is set per ground so it clears 4.5:1 on the card it actually appears on.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer stepping the surface tone (paper → card → muted) over adding a shadow.

dos: Keep gold for money, the one primary action, and active state — under 15% of a screen
Scope .dark to film frames only; leave <html> on the paper ground
Use text-gold-foreground on a gold fill so it flips with the ground
Set page titles in Serif Display, editorial prose in Serif Text, every control in Sans
Use the two-weight headline where copy splits on a comma
Wrap Latin runs in .ltr-island / .numeric, and unknown-script user text in <bdi>
Reach for a tonal step (paper → card → muted) before a shadow
Use the letterbox (2.39:1) for hero crops and empty states
donts: Put .dark on <html> or on a chrome surface
Hard-code text-ink on a gold fill
Put gold on hover borders, heading hovers, or stat figures that are not money
Introduce a second accent hue or a gradient
Force 16:9 on a clip whose real aspect is 9:16
Use left/right or ml/mr — logical properties only
Let a status colour become a brand accent
Ship a headline in Sans or a data-table label in Serif Display
narrative.paletteNote: The earth palette is activated per docs/design-language.md §2.2: sand as a warm neutral ground (alternating sections, empty states, the dashboard rail), oasis for cleared/verified, clay for attention, mixed-hue icon chips across feature grids. Gold stays rationed to money/action/active. Headlines are Black (900) two-weight; prose is 1.2rem (1.35rem lead).
